note: BH-9071: 1 = before the conductor adds merge-queue to a READY, not-yet-queued PR on a Mergify repo, it reads the check runs of the PR head. A latest end-to-end check (name matches MC_E2E_CHECK_RE) with conclusion failure holds the PR: one log line and one PR comment per (PR, head). A running one holds it silently until it finishes. A PR labelled fix-main-red is not read. A new commit clears the hold. 0 = off. Not a whole number reads as 1. Per-project row: lane.merge-conductor.<project>.mc_e2e_red_hold.
